description: This file implements shared channel notification handling in Mattermost, including websocket event processing for content sync and invitations, managing remote clusters, and channel sharing logic.

classes.name: PlatformService
classes.description: Represents the platform service handling shared channel websocket events.

methods.name: SharedChannelSyncHandler
methods.description: Handles websocket events for shared channel synchronization, delegating to content sync or invitation handling based on event type.

methods.name: isEligibleForEvents
methods.description: Checks if a websocket event is eligible for processing based on the sync service and event type.

methods.name: eventHasChannel
methods.description: Determines if a websocket event has an associated broadcast channel.

methods.name: syncServiceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the shared channel sync service is active.

methods.name: handleContentSync
methods.description: Performs content synchronization for a shared channel when a relevant websocket event occurs.

methods.name: handleInvitation
methods.description: Handles sending channel invitations for shared channels based on websocket events.

methods.name: getUserFromEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a user object from websocket event data using a specified key.

methods.name: findChannel
methods.description: Finds a channel by ID, returning an error if not found.
